profile_text.body:
AppLovin Corp is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and trades under the ticker APP. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001751008. According to its website, AppLovin provides advertising solutions for mobile games, saying it reaches over a billion daily users in mobile games and helps consumer brands and gaming apps scale their business profitably. The site lists consumer brands, gaming apps, and agencies among its audiences, and describes its ads as running fullscreen during natural pauses in the game experience or being chosen in exchange for rewards.

The site names jewelry, furniture, fitness subscriptions, and word games as examples of businesses it serves, and offers a dashboard, a Shopify app, a pixel helper, and a strategy call as entry points. It also links to policy pages covering terms of use, publisher policies, demand partner policies, platform enforcement, privacy, and cookie settings.

The record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers tracked for the company. It notes law exposure in California, with a count of 281.
